title: Choose the right level of support
introduction: From a targeted diagnosis to full governance, ARCHERITAGE adapts its engagement to the project’s real state, the decisions required and the stakeholders involved.

items.title: Valorise land or a territory
items.text: Feasibility, parcel optimisation, subdivision or territorial strategy: turn a site into a clear, argued project.
items.formats: Possible formats: flash diagnosis or feasibility study

items.title: Build or transform a major project
items.text: Design, framing, coordination or governance of an operation involving multiple stakeholders.
items.formats: Possible formats: owner’s advisory, audit or full governance

items.title: Restore or valorise heritage
items.text: Diagnosis, restoration, rehabilitation or adaptive reuse of a historic site with adapted steering.
items.formats: Possible formats: diagnosis, study or owner’s advisory

items.name: Flash diagnosis
items.outcome: A rapid reading of a land, architectural or heritage situation to clarify the first stakes.

items.name: Feasibility study
items.outcome: Analysis of a site’s or project’s potential before an investment, programming or commitment decision.

items.name: Owner’s advisory support
items.outcome: Structured support through sensitive phases, trade-offs and project coordination.

items.name: Audit and recovery
items.outcome: Analysis of a blocked or insufficiently governed project to clarify risks and priority actions.

items.name: Full governance engagement
items.outcome: Documentary and operational steering of the project according to PATRIGOV principles.

audience.title: Public and private project owners
audience.text: Institutions, local authorities, development agencies, investors and project owners engaged in complex or sensitive operations.

finalCta: Describe your project so we can identify the right form of support.
